services.name: Deck removal
services.blurb: Boards, joists and posts taken down, footings pulled and the screws picked up with a magnet.

services.name: Shed and garage removal
services.blurb: Sheds and detached one- or two-car garages taken down, with the slab removed if you want.

services.name: Hot tub removal
services.blurb: Power disconnected by your electrician, the tub cut in sections and carried out through the gate.

services.name: Above-ground pool removal
services.blurb: Liner, walls and frame taken apart, the water drained where the city allows, the sand raked level.

services.name: Concrete patio breakup
services.blurb: Patios, walks and old slabs broken up, rebar cut, and hauled to a concrete recycler.

services.name: Kitchen and bath tear-out
services.blurb: Cabinets, tile and fixtures out to the studs, lines capped, the room sealed in plastic.

services.name: Basement tear-out
services.blurb: Wet or moldy drywall, carpet and paneling cut out after water, bagged and hauled on the same visit.

services.name: Debris hauling
services.blurb: Piles left by another crew or a DIY weekend loaded, weighed and taken to the right yard.

services.name: Written scope and load estimate
services.blurb: A written list of what comes out, what stays and the loads we expect, before we start.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: The written scope said three trailer loads for our deck. It was three, and the tickets from the transfer station came by email that night with the weights on them. No contractor has ever sent me that.
reviews.name: Craig W.

reviews.text: The hot tub had been dead since before we bought the house. Our electrician pulled the wire in the morning, they cut the shell into four pieces and had it through a 36-inch gate by noon.
reviews.name: Lynn T.

reviews.text: Our detached garage in the Old West End was leaning toward the neighbor's fence. They handled the permit and the utility letter, took it down in a day and a half, and the fence never got touched.
reviews.name: Marcus D.

reviews.text: After the river came up into our Point Place basement, they cut out the paneling and drywall, bagged it all, and had the walls open for the drying crew the next morning.
reviews.name: Joanne K.

reviews.text: Above-ground pool, the old deck around it and a pile of sand. They drained it where the city allows, took it apart, and left the lawn raked and ready for seed.
reviews.name: Devon H.

reviews.text: Cracked patio, about 300 square feet. They broke it up, cut the rebar, and the ticket showed it went to a concrete recycler and not the landfill, which mattered to me.
reviews.name: Rosa M.

reviews.text: Short version: a previous contractor left a mountain of drywall and old cabinets in my garage. Two trailer loads, two tickets, garage swept.
reviews.name: Phil N.

proof.guarantee: Your written scope is the price; if we find more, we stop and show you before any extra work.

prices.note: one or two cars, slab priced separately
